        self,
        data_path: str,
        tokenizer: AutoTokenizer,
        max_seq_length: int,
        num_negatives: int,
        pos_weight_alpha: float,
        use_fusion_head: bool,

        self.max_seq_length = max_seq_length
        self.num_negatives = num_negatives

        self.use_fusion_head = use_fusion_head

        with open(data_path) as f:

            negs = mined.get(qid, [])
            self._negatives[idx] = negs

            padding=False, return_tensors=None,
        )

        pos_weight = math.exp(-self.alpha * dist)

{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
# ============================================================================
# run_m2_full_bm25_qwen.sh — BM25 negative strategy Phase 2 training (Qwen)
#
# Runs 3 seeds sequentially. Config matches other M2 strategies exactly,
# except: s42 uses 3 epochs; s43/s44 use 2 epochs + early_stopping_patience=2.
#
# Usage:
#   nohup bash run_m2_full_bm25_qwen.sh > /root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/full_m2_outputs/bm25_qwen_schedule.log 2>&1 &
# ============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

PROJECT_ROOT="/root/structfuse"
MODEL_PATH="/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/models/Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-3B"
DATA_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/full_m2_training_data"
OUTPUT_BASE="/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/full_m2_outputs"
GPU_ID="${1:-0}"

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$GPU_ID"
export WANDB_MODE=offline
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1

# Activate conda
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

# ── Seed configs: (seed, epochs, early_stopping_patience) ──
declare -a SEEDS=(42 43 44)
declare -A EPOCHS=([42]=2 [43]=2 [44]=2)
declare -A PATIENCE=([42]=2 [43]=2 [44]=2)

echo "============================================"
echo " BM25 Qwen M2 Full Training"
echo " Seeds: ${SEEDS[*]}"
echo " GPU: $GPU_ID"
echo " Start: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
echo "============================================"

for SEED in "${SEEDS[@]}"; do
    STRATEGY="bm25"
    NUM_EPOCHS="${EPOCHS[$SEED]}"
    ESP="${PATIENCE[$SEED]}"
    OUTPUT_DIR="${OUTPUT_BASE}/bm25_s${SEED}"
    TRAIN_FILE="${DATA_DIR}/train_bm25_s${SEED}.jsonl"
    VAL_FILE="${DATA_DIR}/val_bm25_s${SEED}.jsonl"
    LOG_FILE="${OUTPUT_DIR}/train.log"

    # Pre-flight checks
    for f in "$TRAIN_FILE" "$VAL_FILE" "$MODEL_PATH/config.json"; do
        if [ ! -e "$f" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: required file not found: $f"
            exit 1
        fi
    done

    mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR"

    echo ""
    echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] START bm25_s${SEED} (epochs=${NUM_EPOCHS}, patience=${ESP})"

    TRAIN_CMD=(
        python -u "${PROJECT_ROOT}/training/train.py"
        --model-name "$MODEL_PATH"
        --train-file "$TRAIN_FILE"
        --val-file "$VAL_FILE"
        --output-dir "$OUTPUT_DIR"
        --hard-negative-strategy "$STRATEGY"
        --seed "$SEED"
        --batch-size 8
        --num-negatives 7
        --max-seq-length 2048
        --num-epochs "$NUM_EPOCHS"
        --learning-rate 2e-5
        --eval-steps 500
        --save-steps 1000
        --use-lora
        --gradient-checkpointing
        --wandb-project structfuse
        --wandb-run-name "full_m2_bm25_s${SEED}"
    )

    if [ "$ESP" -gt 0 ]; then
        TRAIN_CMD+=(--early-stopping-patience "$ESP")
    fi

    echo "CMD: ${TRAIN_CMD[*]}" | tee "$LOG_FILE"
    "${TRAIN_CMD[@]}" 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"

    echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] DONE bm25_s${SEED}"
done

echo ""
echo "============================================"
echo " ALL BM25 QWEN RUNS COMPLETED"
echo " End: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
echo "============================================"
", "stderr": "", "return_code": 0}, "error": null, "metadata": {"elapsed_seconds": 0.36}}

{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
# ============================================================================
# run_m2_s42_supplement.sh — M2 Full s42 补充训练
#
# 覆盖: embedding_distance_s42 + dataflow_aware_s42 (Qwen / StarCoder / both)
# D050: s42 统一 2 epochs + early_stopping_patience=2
# ============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

# ── Argument parsing ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
GPU="cuda:0"
ENCODER="both"

while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
        --gpu)
            GPU="$2"
            shift 2
            ;;
        --encoder)
            ENCODER="$2"
            shift 2
            ;;
        *)
            echo "ERROR: Unknown argument: $1"
            echo "Usage: $0 [--gpu cuda:N] [--encoder qwen|starcoder|both]"
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
done

if [[ "$ENCODER" != "qwen" && "$ENCODER" != "starcoder" && "$ENCODER" != "both" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: --encoder must be qwen, starcoder, or both (got: $ENCODER)"
    exit 1
fi

# ── Environment ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
export WANDB_MODE=offline
export WANDB_CONSOLE=off
export WANDB_DIR=/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/wandb_logs/
export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

SEED=42
NUM_EPOCHS=2
STRATEGIES=("embedding_distance" "dataflow_aware")
TRAIN_SCRIPT="/root/structfuse/training/train.py"

echo "============================================"
echo " M2 Full s42 Supplement"
echo " Start: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
echo " GPU: ${GPU} (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES:-not set})"
echo " Encoder: ${ENCODER}"
echo " Strategies: ${STRATEGIES[*]}"
echo " Seed: ${SEED}, Epochs: ${NUM_EPOCHS}"
echo "============================================"

# ── Training function ────────────────────────────────────────────────
run_training() {
    local encoder_name="$1"
    local model_path="$2"
    local data_dir="$3"
    local out_base="$4"
    local log_dir="$5"
    local wandb_prefix="$6"

    mkdir -p "${log_dir}" "${out_base}"

    for STRATEGY in "${STRATEGIES[@]}"; do
        TAG="${STRATEGY}_s${SEED}"
        TRAIN_FILE="${data_dir}/train_${STRATEGY}_s${SEED}.jsonl"
        VAL_FILE="${data_dir}/val_${STRATEGY}_s${SEED}.jsonl"
        OUT_DIR="${out_base}/${TAG}"
        LOG_FILE="${log_dir}/${TAG}.log"

        echo ""
        echo "=========================================="
        echo " [${encoder_name}] ${TAG}"
        echo " Train: ${TRAIN_FILE}"
        echo " Output: ${OUT_DIR}"
        echo " Log: ${LOG_FILE}"
        echo "=========================================="

        if [ ! -f "${TRAIN_FILE}" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Train file not found: ${TRAIN_FILE}"
            exit 1
        fi
        if [ ! -f "${VAL_FILE}" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Val file not found: ${VAL_FILE}"
            exit 1
        fi

        mkdir -p "${OUT_DIR}"

        EXTRA_ARGS=""
        if [ "${STRATEGY}" = "dataflow_aware" ]; then
            if [ -f "${data_dir}/dataflow_graph.json" ]; then
                EXTRA_ARGS="--dataflow-graph-file ${data_dir}/dataflow_graph.json"
            else
                echo "ERROR: dataflow_graph.json not found in ${data_dir}"
                exit 1
            fi
        fi

        python -u "${TRAIN_SCRIPT}" \
            --model-name "${model_path}" \
            --train-file "${TRAIN_FILE}" \
            --val-file "${VAL_FILE}" \
            --output-dir "${OUT_DIR}" \
            --hard-negative-strategy "${STRATEGY}" \
            --seed "${SEED}" \
            --batch-size 8 \
            --num-negatives 7 \
            --max-seq-length 2048 \
            --num-epochs "${NUM_EPOCHS}" \
            --learning-rate 2e-5 \
            --temperature 0.07 \
            --hard-negative-ratio 0.5 \
            --eval-steps 500 \
            --save-steps 1000 \
            --use-lora \
            --gradient-checkpointing \
            --early-stopping-patience 2 \
            --wandb-project structfuse \
            --wandb-run-name "${wandb_prefix}_${TAG}" \
            ${EXTRA_ARGS} \
            2>&1 | tee "${LOG_FILE}"

        echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] DONE: ${encoder_name} ${TAG}"

        if [ -f "${OUT_DIR}/best_by_val_loss/training_config.json" ]; then
            echo "  best_by_val_loss checkpoint saved"
        fi
        if [ -f "${OUT_DIR}/best_by_recall_at_1/training_config.json" ]; then
            echo "  best_by_recall_at_1 checkpoint saved"
        fi

        find "${OUT_DIR}" -maxdepth 1 -name "checkpoint-*" -type d -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
        echo ""
    done
}

# ── Qwen ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if [[ "$ENCODER" == "qwen" || "$ENCODER" == "both" ]]; then
    echo ""
    echo "╔══════════════════════════════════════════╗"
    echo "║  Qwen2.5-Coder-3B  s42 Supplement       ║"
    echo "╚══════════════════════════════════════════╝"
    run_training \
        "Qwen" \
        "/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/models/Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-3B" \
        "/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/full_m2_training_data" \
        "/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/checkpoints/m2_full_qwen" \
        "/root/runs/m2_full_qwen" \
        "m2_full"
fi

# ── StarCoder ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if [[ "$ENCODER" == "starcoder" || "$ENCODER" == "both" ]]; then
    echo ""
    echo "╔══════════════════════════════════════════╗"
    echo "║  StarCoder2-3B  s42 Supplement           ║"
    echo "╚══════════════════════════════════════════╝"
    run_training \
        "StarCoder" \
        "/root/autodl-tmp/models/bigcode/starcoder2-3b/bigcode/starcoder2-3b" \
        "/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/full_m2_starcoder_data" \
        "/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/checkpoints/m2_full_starcoder" \
        "/root/runs/m2_full_starcoder" \
        "m2_full_sc2"
fi

echo "============================================"
echo " ALL SUPPLEMENT RUNS COMPLETED"
echo " End: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
echo "============================================"

## 审查报告 — Qwen 训练链状态 + Bootstrap v3 交叉验证（2026-05-15）

**结论**: WARNING

### 发现

**1. [severity: warning] Bootstrap v3 R@1 与训练时 R@1 存在 1.05pp 差异**

bootstrap_paired_test.py (PID 4545) 对 random_s43 独立评估得 R@1=0.5449，但训练日志记录的 best_R@1=0.5554。两者使用相同 checkpoint（`m2_full_qwen/random_s43/best_by_recall_at_1`，完整 6.2GB 模型）和相同验证集（`val_random_s43.jsonl`，3052 instances），差异来源不明。

可能原因：pool 构建逻辑不同（bootstrap 报告 min_pool=3, max_pool=8, mean=7.8，部分 instance 不足 8 个 candidate；训练 eval 可能处理方式不同），或 batch 处理/padding 策略差异。

**影响**：paired bootstrap 测的是两模型间 delta（相对值），如果两模型 R@1 都系统性偏移相同量级，delta 仍可信。但在 paper 中引用 bootstrap 的绝对 R@1 数值时需注意——不能混用 bootstrap 绝对值和训练时绝对值。需调查根因后决定以哪套数字为准。

**2. [severity: info] embed_s44 后处理评估中，Registry 标注不准**

Registry 标注 "current_subrun: dataflow_s43 (5/7)" 但实际 PID 891739（embed_s44 train.py）仍在运行，GPU 0 占用 50592 MiB。原因：train.py 在 early stop 后执行 `final_metrics = evaluate()`——全量验证集推理，预计耗时 30-45 分钟。进程未卡死（State=R, 114 threads, 100% GPU util）。

**影响**：dataflow_s43 尚未开始，Qwen 链 ETA 需顺延约 1 小时。主链完成后 watcher PID 966920（alive 1d+）将触发 embed_s42/dataflow_s42 supplement。

**3. [severity: warning] embed_s44 R@1 过拟合模式——harder negatives 加速 R@1 退化**

embed_s44 训练轨迹：
- eval@500: val_loss=0.4403, **R@1=0.5942** ← 峰值
- eval@1000: val_loss=**0.4341** (loss 改善！), R@1=0.5813 (-1.29pp)
- eval@1500: val_loss=0.5256, R@1=0.5473 (-4.69pp from peak)
- eval@2000: val_loss=0.5182, R@1=0.5390 → early stop

对比 random_s44: best_R@1=0.6009 (比 embed_s44 峰值高 0.67pp), early_stopped step 1500

关键观察：**R@1 在 step 500 达峰后持续下滑，而 val_loss 在 step 1000 才达最优**——这是明确的 checkpoint 指标分歧（§4.3.1），且 embedding-distance 策略下分歧比 random 更严重。这意味着：
- dual-checkpoint protocol 不仅是 robustness check，对于 harder negative 策略是必需的
- 论文应讨论 harder negatives 可能加速 R@1 overfitting 的机制（InfoNCE loss 继续改善但检索排名退化）

**4. [severity: info] GPU 资源合规**

GPU 0: PID 891739 (50592 MiB) + PID 4545 bootstrap (10198 MiB) = 60790 MiB / 97887 MiB
GPU 1: PID 913995 StarCoder (55078 MiB) / 97887 MiB
均在 gpu_ids=[0,1] 白名单内。✓

**5. [severity: info] StarCoder 链正常推进**

random_s44 at step 1400/2816 (~50%), eval@500 R@1=0.4848, eval@1000 R@1=0.4812 (val_loss not improved 1/2). 链顺利。

### 建议

1. **调查 bootstrap R@1 差异根因**：在 bootstrap v3 完成后，对比两套数字的 per-instance 匹配情况。如果系统性偏移，bootstrap 仍可用于 paired test，但 paper Table 1 应统一使用训练时 eval 数字。
2. **Paper §4.3.1 可用 embed_s44 作具体案例**：step 500 (best R@1) vs step 1000 (best loss) 的分歧非常 clean，适合展示 dual-checkpoint 的必要性。
3. **Registry 应添加 embed_s44 完整轨迹**：当前只有 summary metrics，4 个 eval point 的完整数据对 §4.3.3 Training Dynamics 分析很有价值。

Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).
TRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.
SKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a pull request
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch
